 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Separator lines divide the grid into equal-sized tiles. Mark tiles
    # containing exactly two instances of the non-background, non-separator color.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = max(set(grid[0]), key=lambda c: sum(all(row[j] == c for row in grid) for j in range(w)))
    # Identify complete horizontal and vertical separator lines.
    hr = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == sep for v in row)]
    vc = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == sep for i in range(h))]
    r_edges = [-1] + hr + [h]
    c_edges = [-1] + vc + [w]
    bg = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v != sep and sum(r.count(v) for r in grid) > 0)
    # The marker is the other non-separator color; tiles with two markers map to 1.
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != sep}
    marker = max(colors, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    bg = next(v for v in colors if v != marker)
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(r_edges)-1):
        r0, r1 = r_edges[ri]+1, r_edges[ri+1]
        line = []
        for ci in range(len(c_edges)-1):
            c0, c1 = c_edges[ci]+1, c_edges[ci+1]
            n = sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            line.append(1 if n == 2 else bg)
        out.append(line)
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
